item.ancient_extensions.pokeball_pouch.d: Stores Poké Balls only. Craft with any Poké Ball—the ball sets look and capacity.
item.ancient_extensions.pokeball_pouch.p: Place on the ground to set down, or use in hand to open.
item.ancient_extensions.regional_passpor: Your stamped survey origin—choose once, then carry it on every route.
item.ancient_extensions.regional_survey_: Your live field log—goals, catches, and migration progress. Right-click to read.
item.ancient_extensions.field_survey_cal: Wall calendar with a seasonal spawn estimate for this location. Less accurate than a Field Survey Sensor on Create.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.discla: Estimate only — based on migration spawn tables, not live field telemetry.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.no_ser: Calendar data is only available on the server.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.biome_: Could not read the biome at this calendar.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.vanill: Vanilla biome: showing route-wide seasonal weights (rough guess).
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.no_spa: No migratory spawn entries match this biome this season.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.sensor: For live readouts, use a Field Survey Sensor with Create Display Links.
ancient_extensions.guide.field_calendar_: Hang on a wall at camp; right-click for a spawn estimate at that spot.
Uses pool weights + biome tags — the Create sensor is the authoritative source.
item.ancient_extensions.field_survey_sen: Reads migration season, biome route, and migratory spawns at this location for Create Display Links.
item.ancient_extensions.field_survey_mon: Shows up to four lines from a Create Display Link—ideal for a camp migration board.
ancient_extensions.field_sensor.hint_cre: Use a Create Display Link: target your monitor or sign, then place the link on this sensor. Choose a field source (season, biome, or species).
ancient_extensions.field_sensor.hint_no_: Install Create and craft this sensor with brass + your Field Survey Tablet to feed Display Links.
ancient_extensions.field_monitor.hint_cr: Use a Create Display Link: target this monitor, then place the link on a Field Survey Sensor.
ancient_extensions.field_monitor.hint_no: Install Create to display live migration readouts on this monitor.
item.ancient_extensions.field_survey_tel: Backpack upgrade that caches live migration readouts at your position while the bag is worn.
Install in a Sophisticated Backpack upgrade slot.
ancient_extensions.sb.telemetry.tooltip_: No readout yet — wear the backpack outdoors to scan.
ancient_extensions.sb.telemetry.conflict: Only one Field Survey Telemetry upgrade per backpack.
ancient_extensions.guide.sb_telemetry_de: Optional with Sophisticated Backpacks: mobile season, biome, and species lines on the upgrade tooltip.
Craft with SB upgrade base + Field Survey Tablet; the Create sensor remains the fixed-camp authority.
item.ancient_extensions.migration_route_: Points toward the nearest biome on your active migration leg—the needle follows your target while held (right-click to refresh).
ancient_extensions.compass.tooltip_use: Use to scan your route. Sneak + use with a target set to offer a map waypoint.
ancient_extensions.compass.on_route: You are on route at %s · leg %s/%s · %s/%s migratory catches
ancient_extensions.compass.not_found: No route biome found within range · leg %s/%s
ancient_extensions.compass.waypoint_tip: Sneak + use to place a map waypoint (JourneyMap / coords).
ancient_extensions.compass.waypoint_jm_h: JourneyMap: click the line above to create a waypoint.
ancient_extensions.compass.waypoint_xaer: Xaero's: press B, add waypoint at the coordinates below.
ancient_extensions.guide.compass_detail1: Scans the world for the closest biome on your current migration leg.
ancient_extensions.guide.compass_detail2: The needle locks while you hold the compass; rescan with use.
ancient_extensions.guide.compass_detail3: Field Survey Sensor + Create still gives the strongest live readout at a fixed camp.
ancient_extensions.guide.field_sensor_de: Place where you want world data read (camp, route stop, lab).
Display Link sources: season + calendar, biome/route leg, migratory species preview.
ancient_extensions.guide.field_monitor_d: Four-line in-world display target for Create Display Links.
Link sensor → monitor for a live migration board at base.
item.ancient_extensions.field_survey_tab: Your pocket field dashboard—live survey status and quick links to journal tools.
ancient_extensions.tablet.tooltip_use: Right-click to open the field dashboard.
ancient_extensions.tablet.welcome: You received a Field Survey Tablet—right-click it for live survey status and shortcuts.
ancient_extensions.tablet.empty: No survey data yet—catch Pokémon on your route to begin.
item.ancient_extensions.migration_route_: Field map for the current migration season—your biome, route legs, and which species count.
ancient_extensions.guide.chart_detail1: Updates when opened: season, active leg, your biome, route biomes, and migratory species.
ancient_extensions.guide.chart_detail2: Catch migratory Pokémon on the active leg to advance. Almost any Flying-type counts; listed species also spawn on the route.
ancient_extensions.guide.chart_trade: Journeyman Cartographers sell this chart for 7 emeralds and a compass.
ancient_extensions.guide.journal_detail1: Full field log: research rank, goals, migration progress, and rank rewards.
ancient_extensions.guide.journal_detail2: Use Claim rank rewards at the bottom when a tier is ready.
ancient_extensions.guide.tablet_detail1: Quick dashboard with live stats and shortcuts to journal, passport, and chart.
ancient_extensions.guide.tablet_detail2: Best for checking goals in the field without reading every journal page.
ancient_extensions.guide.passport_detail: Choose your survey origin region and hometown once—the stamp is permanent.
Shows your origin on the journal and may add a colored tag in multiplayer.
ancient_extensions.guide.kit_detail1: One-time use: pitches a survey camp with supplies and a briefing lectern.
ancient_extensions.guide.kit_detail2: Granted on first join; not craftable.
ancient_extensions.guide.pouch_detail1: Stores Poké Balls only. Craft with any Poké Ball in the center—the ball sets tier and slot count.
ancient_extensions.migration_chart.toolt: Right-click to read the chart for where you are standing.
ancient_extensions.migration_chart.empty: No route data available. Stand in a loaded world and open the chart again.
ancient_extensions.migration_chart.guide: • [>] = your active leg; [x] = finished; [ ] = not started.

• Any vanilla biome counts on the active leg; RU biomes are listed per leg.
• Catch migratory species here (Flying-types and listed species) to advance.

ancient_extensions.jei.pokeball_pouch.re: Craft in a 3×3 grid: leather on the corners and sides, string on top, any Poké Ball in the center, and one leather below the ball.
ancient_extensions.jei.pokeball_pouch.ti: Great, Ultra, and Master Balls upgrade pouch capacity and appearance.
ancient_extensions.jei.pokeball_pouch.ce: Use any ball from the Cobblemon Poké Balls tag in the center slot.
ancient_extensions.jei.pokeball_pouch.le: Leather forms the pouch frame in the crafting grid.
ancient_extensions.jei.pokeball_pouch.st: String makes the shoulder strap on the top row.
item.ancient_extensions.ancient_professo: Right-click open ground ahead to pitch a comfort survey camp—fire, tent, bedroll, and a supply chest.
ancient_extensions.kit.welcome: The Ancient Professor left you a Field Kit. Open your inventory and right-click it on open ground.
ancient_extensions.kit.welcome_hint: Pitch your camp to begin the Regional Survey.
ancient_extensions.kit.tooltip_use: Faces open ground in front of you when used.
ancient_extensions.kit.lectern_hint: The Regional Survey Briefing is on the camp lectern—take a copy from your pack too.
ancient_extensions.kit.given: Ancient Professor's Field Kit added to your inventory.
ancient_extensions.kit.deployed: You pitched the survey camp—a fire, tent, and bedroll are ready. Open the chest for backup supplies.
ancient_extensions.kit.comfort_hint: Rest by the campfire or use the bedroll. Starter gear is in the camp chest.
ancient_extensions.kit.inventory_hint: Starter supplies are in your inventory. Read the briefing on the camp lectern.
ancient_extensions.kit.chest_only_hint: Starter supplies are in the camp chest—open it to gear up.
ancient_extensions.kit.bed_spawn_hint: Right-click the camp bed to set your respawn point here.
ancient_extensions.kit.sleeping_bag_hint: A sleeping bag is laid out by the fire—right-click it to rest without moving your spawn.
ancient_extensions.kit.lootr_hint: The camp chest uses Lootr—every player gets their own starter supplies.
ancient_extensions.kit.survey_hint: Only catches count toward the Regional Survey (PC storage does not). Use /ancientextensions survey
ancient_extensions.kit.chest_hint: Open the camp chest for your starter Poké Balls and medicine.
ancient_extensions.kit.already_used: This kit has already been opened on your journey.
ancient_extensions.kit.no_space: There is not enough open ground nearby to pitch the camp. Try a clearer area.
ancient_extensions.advancement.pitch_fie: Pitch the Ancient Professor's field camp to begin the Regional Survey.
ancient_extensions.dex.tier_up_rewards: Open your Regional Survey Journal to claim rank rewards.

ancient_extensions.migration.diminished_: Repeat route reward is reduced for this season (completion #%s).

ancient_extensions.journal.hint: Open your Regional Survey Journal to see which goals are done and what is next.
ancient_extensions.journal.given: Regional Survey Journal added to your inventory.
ancient_extensions.journal.tooltip_use: Right-click to open your field log.
ancient_extensions.journal.next_rank: Next rank: %s in %s RP (%s RP total)

ancient_extensions.journal.reward_claim_: Use Claim rank rewards below, or /ancientextensions rewards claim.
ancient_extensions.journal.empty: No survey data yet. Pitch your camp and catch Pokémon in the wild.

ancient_extensions.passport.welcome: You received a Regional Survey Passport—right-click it to choose your origin region and hometown (Kanto, Johto, and others). This choice is permanent.
ancient_extensions.passport.welcome_mca: You received a Regional Survey Passport. After you finish the MCA character and destiny intro, you will choose your survey origin region and hometown—the stamp is permanent.
ancient_extensions.passport.welcome_opti: You received a Regional Survey Passport. Your server may assign a survey origin, or you can right-click the passport to choose one yourself.
ancient_extensions.passport.given: Regional Survey Passport added to your inventory.
ancient_extensions.passport.choose_promp: Open the region list and stamp your passport with your home region.
ancient_extensions.passport.not_register: Your passport is not stamped yet. Right-click it to choose your origin.
ancient_extensions.passport.footer: Valid for all seasonal migration routes on this world.

ancient_extensions.origin.chosen_hint: Your journal and migration bonuses now reference this region. Other players will see your colored region tag in chat and above your head.

ancient_extensions.region.kanto.blurb: The classic heartland—oak routes, league dreams, and endless tall grass.
ancient_extensions.region.johto.blurb: Legends linger among towers and quiet routes between mountains and sea.
ancient_extensions.region.hoenn.blurb: Land and sea intertwine; volcanic paths and tropical shores shape every survey.
ancient_extensions.region.sinnoh.blurb: Mythic peaks and harsh winters—migratory lines bend around Mount Coronet.
ancient_extensions.region.unova.blurb: Urban skylines and distant frontiers—contrasts that define modern field work.
ancient_extensions.region.kalos.blurb: Elegant valleys and radiant meadows where beauty and battle meet.
ancient_extensions.region.alola.blurb: Island chains and guardian spirits—every leg of migration crosses open ocean.
ancient_extensions.region.galar.blurb: Rolling wild areas and stadium culture—open moors host seasonal wanderers.
ancient_extensions.region.paldea.blurb: A vast open region—treasure hunts and terastal light guide surveyors inland.
